classification.difficultyReason: Read four function values directly from a supplied cosine graph.

content.prompt: This graph shows $\cos\theta$. Use it to estimate the following to 2 d.p.

spec.sourceRegion: Q1 supplied graph between the stem and parts a–d
spec.description: Cosine curve on an unshaded rectangular grid, centred above the four response cells. Q2 also refers to this graph.
spec.mathematics: y=cos(theta), with theta in degrees; grid steps 10 degrees and 0.1. Labelled horizontal ticks 90, 180, 270 and 360; labelled vertical ticks -1, -0.5, 0.5 and 1. Curve has a right continuation arrow.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied curve, axes, ticks and grid remain visible; no answer readings or solution guides appear.

answer.worked:

$$\cos35^{\circ}\approx0.82$$
